artifacts.title: Consecutive service on different GA committees without sabbatical
artifacts.disposition: No (not eligible); Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a GA permanent committee member who completed a full term is not eligible for consecutive service on a different committee or agency board without a sabbatical year.

artifacts.title: SJC member eligibility for concurrent GA agency board service

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a member of the GA's Standing Judicial Commission is eligible to serve concurrently on the board of a General Assembly agency.

artifacts.title: Which GA entities are subject to the permanent committee ineligibility rule

matches.evidence: The CCB clarified that the "permanent committee" ineligibility provision in RAO 13-2 applies only to the four committees enumerated in RAO 4-2, not to other GA entities.

artifacts.title: Allowing non-ordained persons on GA committees and boards
artifacts.disposition: in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: An Ohio Valley Presbytery overture to amend BCO 14-1 to permit non-ordained persons to serve on GA committees and boards was found in conflict and adopted by the CCB.

artifacts.title: Non-ordained persons on committees and boards, Rocky Mountain version
artifacts.disposition: in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: A Rocky Mountain Presbytery overture to amend BCO 14-1 permitting non-ordained persons to serve on GA committees and boards was found in conflict and adopted by the CCB.

artifacts.title: Non-ordained persons on committees and boards, second version
artifacts.disposition: in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: A Southern New England Presbytery version of the overture to allow non-ordained persons on GA committees and boards was found in conflict and adopted by the CCB.

artifacts.title: Non-ordained persons on committees and boards, third version
artifacts.disposition: in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: A Nashville Presbytery overture (version 3) to amend BCO 14-1 to allow non-ordained persons on GA committees and boards was found in conflict and adopted by the CCB.

artifacts.title: Non-ordained persons serving on GA committees and boards
artifacts.disposition: in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: This overture to allow non-ordained persons to serve on GA committees and boards was found by the CCB to be in conflict with the BCO.
